meta.title: Breakdown total that does not match the auction bid is rejected
gaps: Place the vendor in Cost Breakdown Time.
Edit cost-breakdown line-item prices independently of the submitted auction bid.
Observe the error message showing the remaining reduction amount.
Verify that submission succeeds only when the cost-breakdown total matches the submitted auction bid.
